title: Taking-consensus (morphism)
description: Computes the swarm's consensus over the cell-base — the categorical limit of the multi-observer functor V : O → Settlings_Φ. By Theorem 4.1, the limit is the cellwise ≤_k-meet (knowledge-meet ⊗_k) of the players' settled values. A player with no observation at a cell contributes ⊥ (the ⊗_k absorber), so consensus is cautious: silence at any participant pulls the consensus toward ⊥. Source: swarm. Target: list of (cell, value) consensus entries.
